An attack that, together with allies, focuses a
<c:ffff00>Crossfire<c> <c:ffff00>attack<c> and a <c:ffff00>trigger<c> attack on a single
<c:ffff00>{{target}}<c> at the same time.
The target can only choose its <c:ffff00>{{response}}<c> once, and
responds to all the attacks with the same <c:ffff00>{{part}}<c>.
If <c:ffff00>evading<c> the combo attack fails, evasion will also
fail against the following attacks of that combo. If
the responding {{part}} is <c:ffff00>destroyed<c>, the target will
<c:ffff00>{{take_it}}<c> with its <c:ffff00>head<c> for all those attacks.
